data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'farara', meaning 'to bring forth light or bring news'. In Islamic tradition, Faraal can be seen as a symbol of guidance and enlightenment. The name Faraal carries the meaning “Light Bearer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faraal usually hope their child will grow to embody light bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faraal total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
